plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
Trim SPY to reduce concentration below the 25% limit.
Add to QQQI to increase income exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation by reducing leverage and concentration.
It aims for a lower, steadier return with reduced drawdown potential.
A larger cash buffer is implicitly created by selling riskier assets.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on less volatile assets, aiming for lower drawdowns but also capping upside potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to reduce overall risk.
Trim SPY to bring its concentration down to the 25% limit.
Initiate a new position in TSM, a high-scoring semiconductor setup.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
It aims for a moderate return of approximately 2.5% per month.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a quality name. It seeks risk-first growth, accepting moderate drawdowns for potentially higher returns than the conservative plan.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to maximize potential gains.
Trim SPY to bring its concentration down to the 25% limit.
Initiate new positions in TSM and GEV, both strong scanner setups.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration.
It targets around 4% per month but carries significantly higher drawdown risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive strategy aims for high growth, targeting around 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentration in strong setups. It accepts substantially higher potential drawdowns and requires strict stop discipline due to amplified volatility and leveraged ETF rebalancing effects.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) and high-beta tech (CRWD, SNOW).
Trim SPY to reduce concentration and increase cash buffer.
Significantly increase allocation to QQQI for income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation.
It aims for a low target return of around 1% per month, focusing on yield.
Drawdowns are minimized by holding income-focused and broad index assets.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month by prioritizing yield-generating assets like QQQI and reducing volatile single stocks and leverage. While aiming for low drawdowns and reliable distributions, NAV can still decline in market downturns.
